sn3.4:3.1: Attānañ ce piyaṃ jaññā || na nam pāpena saṃyuje || na hi taṃ sulabhaṃ hoti || sukhaṃ dukkatakārinā || ||
sn3.4:4.1: Antakenādhipannassa || jahato mānusaṃ bhavaṃ || kiṃ hi tassa sakaṃ hoti || kiñca ādāya gacchati || || kiñc-assa anugaṃ hoti || chāyā va anapāyinī || ||
sn3.4:5.1: Ubho puññañca pāpañca || yaṃ macco kurute idha || taṃ hi tassa sakaṃ hoti || tañca ādāya gacchati || taṃ c-assa anugaṃ hoti || chāyā va anapāyinī ||
sn3.4:6.1: Tasmā kareyya kalyāṇaṃ || nicayaṃ samparāyikaṃ || puññāni paralokasmiṃ || patiṭṭhā honti pāṇinan ti || ||
